## Track your brand in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI answers every week

More buyers ask an AI assistant "what's the best X?" before they search. Every Monday this workflow asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews the questions your customers ask, appends one row per question and engine to Google Sheets, and posts a short summary to Slack: is your brand named, in which position, is your site cited, and which competitors are named instead.

**Who's it for**
Marketing and SEO teams, agencies reporting AI visibility (GEO) to clients, and founders watching how AI assistants talk about their product.

**How it works**
1. A schedule trigger fires every Monday morning
2. A Set node holds your brand, websites, competitors, questions and engines
3. The Apify node runs AI Visibility Tracker and waits for the answers
4. One Code node shapes a sheet row per question and engine; another builds the Slack summary
5. Google Sheets appends the rows and Slack posts the summary

**Setup**
1. Create an Apify account and add your API token to the Apify credential
2. Connect Google in the Sheets node (pick a spreadsheet and a tab) and Slack
3. In the Set node, enter your brand, your websites, up to 10 competitors as "Name | domain", your questions and your Slack channel

**Good to know**
$0.02 per check (one question on one engine; a Perplexity answer counts as 2) plus $0.01 per run. 10 questions on the 4 engines cost about $1.01 a week. The Apify node stops a run at $2. Answers change from week to week, so read the trend, not one run.
Actor: https://apify.com/gaelasao/ai-visibility-tracker

### 1. Schedule
Runs every Monday morning. Swap in a manual trigger while you test.

### 2. Your brand
Brand, websites (for citations), competitors as "Name | domain", up to 100 questions, engines, country and Slack channel.

### 3. AI answers
Runs AI Visibility Tracker on Apify: one row per question and engine. The run stops at $1 (node setting).

### 4. Rows and summary
One Code node shapes the sheet rows, the other builds the Slack message from the same answers.

### 5. Send
Google Sheets keeps the history; Slack gets the weekly summary. Delete the one you do not use.
